name: Import from Gitea
description: Mirrors a Gitea repo's top-level scripts/ + runners/ folders into this instance (scripts/ -> /app/scripts, runners/ -> /app/conf/runners). Overwrites existing files with the latest version, and REMOVES files that this same source previously imported but no longer has upstream (e.g. you deleted/renamed a script in Gitea) - only files previously imported from this exact url+owner+repo are ever candidates for removal, nothing else under scripts/ or conf/runners/ is touched. Dry-run by default (lists what would change, writes nothing) - check 'apply' to actually sync. No Gitea URL field here either: both the URL and its token(s) live in the Secrets Store's 'gitea' product (key URL, plus one or more token keys) via Secrets Manager - the banner (before you click Run) checks both are set and confirms the token actually works. Repo below then lists live 'owner/repo' options straight from Gitea for that token, no owner/username to type separately. The manual 'token' field is a one-off override for the actual import step only - Script-Server does not allow a masked/secure field to drive a dropdown, so it can't populate Repo live; use Manual Repo below in that case.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Manual Gitea access token for the actual import step only (Script-Server can't use a masked field to drive the Repo dropdown below - use Manual Repo if you need this).

parameters.name: token_key
parameters.description: Stored Gitea token to use (only needed when more than one is stored under the 'gitea' product) - also what drives the live Repo dropdown below

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Live list of 'owner/repo' options for the stored token above - re-fetches whenever Gitea Token changes. Leave on the error/empty option and use Manual Repo below if this can't be populated (e.g. a public repo with no token, or you're using the manual token field instead).

parameters.name: manual_repo
parameters.description: Fallback when Repo above can't list live (e.g. a public repo with no token) - format owner/repo, e.g. someuser/somerepo. Ignored if Repo has a real selection.

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: Actually sync files (otherwise dry-run only, listing what would change)
